description: This Java source file defines a utility class RmTypeDefs used to find and delete specific typedef annotation classes in an Android project, primarily @IntDef and @StringDef annotations, and to clean up related class files.

classes.name: RmTypeDefs
classes.description: A utility class to identify and remove @IntDef and @StringDef annotation classes from compiled Android code and related cleanup.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line execution; processes arguments and initiates file processing.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the main logic: processes directories, checks class files, and deletes or rewrites class files.

methods.name: checkFile
methods.description: Recursively visits directories and checks each '.class' file.

methods.name: checkClass
methods.description: Reads a class file and inspects it to determine if it is a typedef annotation.

methods.name: addTypeDef
methods.description: Records a class as a typedef annotation and tracks related files.

methods.name: rewriteOuterClasses
methods.description: Modifies outer class files to remove references to typedef inner classes.

methods.name: deleteAnnotationClasses
methods.description: Deletes the class files identified as typedef annotations, respecting dry-run and verbose modes.
